{"notes": "Visit 3 (left at 7:30). Nobody spoke while I was there, so no new statements. Picture: the whole fish (nose, both body arcs, crossing, both tail tips) is still dark, so it is connected to the start. No pale or stranded dominoes, no hand labels, so nobody was touching anything. Lower tail still dense but intact. I still don't know who placed which domino, so I'm not crediting anyone with the build itself.

Maya: No new observations. Visit 1 disclosure of the nudge was honest and proactive; the intact tail supports her handling. Execution and ownership good, collaboration good.

Priya: No new observations. Visit 1 was solid verification and agreement with the plan. Collaboration solid, but I still have no distinct example of impact or leadership. Don't over-rate; rate on what I've seen.

Leo: No new observations. Visit 1 process leadership (stop touching, keep clear of the tail, call out and fix any knock before the push) appears to have been followed, since the table is clean and hands-off. Good leadership evidence, though I can't separate his influence from the team's own discipline.

Tom: Silent and unobserved on all three visits. No basis to rate him up or down. Before the review, ask him privately what he did and checked. Don't penalize quiet.

Team: Calm, disciplined, hands-off finish, good error-reporting norms. Fish intact going into the push."}
